# uv-pbr

First-party declarative Skill `uv-pbr@0.2.0`. It declares typed V2 inputs, a bounded offline-PBR Recipe and product-owned validators; execution is limited to the pre-registered Runtime/Worker operator and does not contain arbitrary code.

This bundle is planning metadata for the single-user MVP. A successful registry or declarative benchmark check does not claim that geometry, render or visual similarity has passed.
